description: Retrieve a comprehensive 360-degree profile of a Croatian company from the Sudski Registar by its unique identifier (OIB or MBS), including legal status and ongoing legal proceedings (such as liquidation or bankruptcy). Always use this as the primary starting point for entity due diligence when an identifier is available. RULES: Never invent, guess, or fabricate company identifiers (OIB/MBS), names, or addresses. If identifier is missing, interview the user first.
name: get_company_by_id
